scope: bounded deterministic logical event scheduling, total tie order and event-budget rejection; no physical clock, interrupt or hard real-time claim; RCL-owned compilation and C VM execution inside actual headless Chromium WebAssembly; no Node-WASI fallback, mobile UI, hosted deployment or whole-family claim

independentGeneration.requestedToolPolicy: read only named frozen candidates; no other filesystem, memory, network, tools or writes

runtimeControls: actual browser compilation and VM execution
page reload and fresh WASI instances
typed roots and source-declared transaction continuity
authorityProfile: actual local Chromium WebAssembly compilation/execution; no Node-WASI fallback, hosted deployment or whole-family claim

trials.intent: Sort events by increasing time, then increasing priority value, then increasing identifier, using a total deterministic order.
Reject an advance when the count of due active events exceeds the event budget; equality is allowed.
An external time proposal requires temporal commit capability equal to one and cannot move logical time backwards.
